This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 121/2023 registered at Police Station - Ghughari, District Mandla (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376(3) &
506-II of IPC and Section 3 read with Section 4(2) of POCSO Act.
As per the prosecution story, on 05.06.2022 complainant lodged a missing complaint against the unknown person that his minor daughter is missing since 30.05.2022.
During the investigation police has recovered the prosecutrix on 21.06.2023 and after recovery prosecutrix made allegation regarding abduction of rape against the present applicant.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 22.06.2022.
It is further submitted that, applicant is in custody since last 1 years and the trial is not concluded.
It is further requested that, he wants to withdraw the present bail application, in case, the trial Court is directed to conclude the trial within some reasonable time.
4. In view of the aforesaid submissions and looking to the facts that applicant is in custody since 22.06.2022, the present bail application is disposed of as withdrawn.
Learned trial Court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously as early as possible preferably within a period of nine months from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, this bail application is disposed of as withdrawn.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Amitabh Annu Vanwashi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65490619/
